trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done, so there is nothing extra to do for it. No online play and no DLC are needed, and the whole set is a single-player job. PowerPyx rates the run 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with the 100% checklist as the longest grind.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and the trophy pops as part of the story. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just keep following the Chapter 1 missions. There is no mission replay, so if you ever worry about a story trophy, keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. It comes automatically while you play through the story, so there is no separate task. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable thing in the whole game: meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions until the chapter ends. The trophy is automatic and cannot be missed. Use the chapter to start the habits that pay off later: scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars whenever you meet them.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Story trophies unlock on their own as you play, so there is no extra step. Chapter 3 is also when several side questlines open — Andy's (Lucia only), Randy's and Tyrone's (Jason only) — so answer their calls when they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4's story missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. It is automatic, like the other chapter trophies. Three mission trophies also sit in Chapter 4 (Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked), and they all pop as you work through the chapter's story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission and this gold trophy pops. It is automatic and unmissable. After the ending the game returns you to free roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and cheats unlock — but keep cheats off your platinum save, because PowerPyx reports they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run to its end. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. If you are tracking story trophies, this is the first of the named-mission trophies — the rest follow the same pattern: finish the named mission, get the trophy.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy pops when the mission ends, with no extra objective to chase. Heist missions are story beats, so just play them through and move on to the next chapter.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play and the trophy unlocks at the end of the mission. It is a straight story trophy — no side objective, no collectible, nothing to prepare. Keep playing the chapter and it will come.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. The trophy pops when the mission is done, automatically. Like the other named-mission trophies, it needs no preparation — it is a marker that you reached this point in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown through to the end. The trophy unlocks with the mission, no extra condition. The mission's airport setting is a story set piece — the separate open-world trophy Catch Me If You Can is the one where you steal a plane yourself.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies and pops automatically when the mission ends. After it, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats — it only appears after the story — and finish it. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but the bar is lenient: it is closer to 60% true completion, most side quests are not required, and you only need 70 of the 80 Challenges. What the checklist does demand in full is every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 200 of 277 vehicle models scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Everything you did during the story already counts toward it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them however you like. There are 397 stunts in the game, so you do not need anywhere near all of them. Stunts you do naturally while driving and flying count too, so keep an eye on the counter in Progress and clean up the remainder with jumps near Vice City.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so this is a quick tour rather than a grind. Do it early — every activity you sample also feeds other trophies, and several of them are required in full for 100% completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the 12 shooting ranges of Leonida. Each challenge is a short timed shooting test, so learn the target pattern, then repeat it until the gold threshold clears. This is one of the few sets the 100% checklist demands in full, so there is no skipping the hard ones — steady aim and the right weapon for each range matter more than speed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 drone race locations. You pilot a drone through the course, so learn the turns before you push for speed — a clean line beats a fast crash. Drone races are also required in full for 100% completion, so every location has to be won, not just visited.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — there are 40 in the game, so pick the half that suits your driving and skip the rest. Each race only needs one win, and a different vehicle class or route can make a hard race easy. Races count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so your first race there does double duty.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His questline starts in Chapter 1, so meet him early and follow his fishing jobs until he challenges you. Fishing is a timing game — wait for the bite, then work the line without snapping it — and winning the challenge pops the trophy on the spot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Beat any one of the 4 video games — three of them are playable on the TV at home, so you do not need to hunt down an arcade. Pick the game whose rules click for you and finish a full run. It also counts as the video-game activity for Master of None.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — 5 quests, played as Lucia only, starting in Chapter 3 — and the trophy pops after the last one. Answer Andy's calls when they come and keep playing as Lucia until the strand ends. Every quest giver tied to a trophy is still around in free roam after the ending, so a strand left unfinished during the story can be completed afterwards.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton, starting in Chapter 1, and the trophy pops after the last one. The wrecks are dive sites around Leonida's coast — take a boat out, dive down, and clear each site. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch mid-story, according to the guides, but he returns, so do not worry if his strand pauses.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, starting in Chapter 2, and the trophy pops after the last one. The Mud Club strand is built around off-road driving and mud racing, so bring a vehicle that handles dirt. Like the other contact strands, it can be finished in free roam after the story.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. There are 14 strands in the game, so you can choose the 8 whose openers you find first — look for the stranger icons on the map and take every one you pass. The named contact strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are separate trophies, but their strands also count toward the 8, so finishing those gets you most of the way there.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.target: 16 cars on Randy's wish list, Ch. 3+
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's wish list, starting in Chapter 3, and the trophy pops after the final delivery. Each car is a specific model to find, steal and bring to Randy — scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app as you go helps you learn what you are looking for. Deliveries can be spread across the story and free roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — played as Jason only, starting in Chapter 3 — by destroying the labs he marks and completing his last quest. The strand is combat-heavy, so go in with armor, ammo and a solid weapon. It can be wrapped up in free roam after the story if you did not finish it during Chapter 3.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and meditate with her. That balcony meditation is only available in Chapter 1 and is not marked as a spot like the others, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it — so do it anyway, then find the other 17 marked spots. There is no mission replay, so a missed balcony meditation cannot be redone on the same save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for — his strand is Jason only. Track it through the hunting grounds Bret points you to, study it through binoculars first if you can, then take the shot cleanly. The exact animal was still being confirmed by the guides at launch, so follow Bret's in-game directions rather than a list: his strand tells you what to hunt and where.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, so pick the 3 whose cards you find first — cards turn up in shops, out in the world and as rewards, and a set completes when you hold every card in it. You do not need all 18 sets, and the checklist only asks for part of the collectibles, so stop at 3 unless you are chasing 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida. Open WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan what it highlights; the scan is quick, so make it a habit and the count climbs on its own. Scanning also discovers vehicles for Whip It Good, so one habit feeds two trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges. The challenges come in 8 groups of 10, covering driving, shooting, exploration and more, and you only need 50 — so skip the hardest ones and clear the groups that suit how you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so the extra 20 you do for A Long Road will already have this trophy in the bag.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape the heat zone. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star level, which is the fastest way to set it up — the trophy often pops by itself during Maximum Withdrawal. For the escape, the guides point to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.target: 3 shops in a row, with partner
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted the whole time — do not lose the wanted level between robberies. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well because they are close together. Note the trophy is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not fire at once.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan of a vehicle is enough to count it, so scan every new car, bike, boat and plane you pass instead of only the ones you drive. The game has 277 base vehicle models, and 100% completion needs 200 scanned, so this trophy pops well before the checklist is done if you scan as you go.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Prepare first: raise your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle for the extra time and damage. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a fight with gang members at one of their illegal operations, where enemies group up and keep coming.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner at Vice City International Airport and fly it at least 1 km away from the airport. The easiest one is docked at terminals E3/E4 — board it, get it moving, and the trophy unlocks once you are 1 km out. Expect a wanted level the moment you take it, so take off fast and do not stop to fight on the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank — the guides point to Mile Zero Air Station, where the tanks are kept. The description's joke is the clue: a Rhino is the game's tank, so getting into one and driving it away is the trophy. Go in with a plan for the military response: grab the tank fast, use its cannon to clear the way, and get out of the base before the response builds up.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which becomes available in Chapter 3 — it lets you crack the cases quietly. Case the store first, move when the staff's attention is elsewhere, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try another store; a failed attempt does not lock you out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. A vault robbery jumps you straight to a 4-star wanted level, so plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked close by and a route out of the heat zone. You do not need all 8 vaults, and each successful escape also feeds Hot Together, so do these with your partner when you can.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — ram one to a stop or block it, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the wanted level that follows. The 100% checklist asks for more robberies than this trophy does, so it usually pops on its own while you work through the robbery requirements.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state, including the islands and the far north, until no grey area is left on the map. It pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies: scan vehicles and WAiNK spots as you cover new ground, and the map fills in while the other counters climb.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 such operations exist across Leonida, so you only need one per gang. Each operation is a defended stash spot: clear the gang members, take the goods and leave. The same spots are good ground for Gunslinger, since PowerPyx notes Combat Focus takedowns count on gang members there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.target: Cocktail with an Ocean Beach view
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach. The official description is the whole clue — a beachfront bar or spot overlooking the ocean, drink in hand. PowerPyx listed this trophy's exact trigger as unknown at launch, so treat the description as the instruction: sit down with a cocktail where the beach is in view and see if it pops. If it does not, check the cited guide — the community was still pinning down the trigger when this guide was written.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the glass of a vehicle showroom and smash your way out, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, build up speed inside or outside, and crash straight through it. PowerPyx listed the exact trigger as unknown at launch — the description reads like a stunt, so the window smash is the move to try, and the cited guide is where the confirmed trigger will be posted.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the bowling alley in Port Gellhorn and follow through there — the guides describe it as taking the key valuables from Kingpin Bowling and then losing the police. Treat it as a small heist at the alley: take what is marked, then break away and lose your wanted level. The name is a nod to the classic bowling pastime, but the trophy itself is the alley job, not a game of bowls.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max Strength, Jason and Lucia together
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles and both bars climb in parallel. Keep at it across sessions — Strength builds up over repeated workouts, not in a single visit.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks how you play — the choices you make, the crimes you commit, the way you treat people — and the counter climbs as you go. There is no single action to farm: just play the game your way, make choices instead of idling, and the 500 will come well before the platinum. Avoid the Irredeemable profile on the way, which PowerPyx warns is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt paying off — fail something, then succeed on the retry. PowerPyx listed this trophy's exact trigger as unknown at launch, so there is no confirmed method to follow yet. The honest approach is to keep playing and retrying the things you fail — a failed stunt, a lost race, a blown robbery — and let the second-try success come naturally, checking the cited guide for the confirmed trigger as the community finds it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida — the description reads like a reaction to an odd event, not a task with a checklist. PowerPyx listed the trigger as unknown at launch, so no confirmed steps exist yet. Explore the map's odd corners, keep an eye out for strange sights while you travel between objectives, and check the cited guide once players have pinned down which event pops it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl your target over. A slow drive past a pedestrian with a bat or similar weapon is the move to try. PowerPyx listed the exact trigger as unknown at launch, so the precise target and speed are still being confirmed — try it on a lone pedestrian away from the police and check the cited guide for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies, so run vaults, trucks and operations, then move the dirty money through a fence a little at a time — the total is cumulative across the whole game, not one job. It pairs with the robbery trophies, so the bills stack up while you chase Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in the game — clothes, weapons, food, car parts — so it climbs on its own as you gear up. If you reach the endgame short of the mark, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off: weapons, upgrades and property-adjacent purchases all count.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties — about $160,000 in total. Garages are bought through the property listings, and each one gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect. Save up during the story and buy them as you can afford them; the last one pops the trophy, and the garages make the vehicle trophies easier afterwards.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat until 10 are on the books. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive daily and top up with cheap finds. It is a quick cleanup trophy for the endgame.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
